correctness.rationale: Exposed vertices of unit tube simplex-sum K_m are in one-to-one correspondence with ordered lists of distinct leaves above hub. The exact count m! F_m(1) makes J=m-k reciprocal-factorial under UNIFORM DISTINCT VERTEX sampling, a crucial measure distinction. From H=2^J and T=2^m-H, U=(4^m-H²)/3, compute barycenter and two covariance eigenvalues by permutation symmetry and trace; all-dimensional strict switch follows exact cases m=2,3,4,5 and inequalities for m>=6; asymptotics from F_m(z)->exp(z). Independent exact rational finite enumerations m=2..5 reproduced 5,16,65,326 vertices and both eigenvalues; source verify.py also checks m=6 and eigen ordering to 64, not an infinite proof.
residual_risks: Uniform over generic objective chambers is NOT vertex-uniform; proof counts distinct vertices correctly.
All-m transition relies on analytic bounds not finite verifier.

value.rationale: Exact full vertex inertia spectrum of canonical star graph-associahedron and strict top-principal-component crossover at four leaves are natural metric invariants. Exponential growth of leaf contrast versus bounded hub variance provides a reusable benchmark distinguishing combinatorics, geometry and sampling measure.
residual_risks: Scope limited to unit simplex tube weights and distinct-vertex uniform sampling.

limitations: No claim for volume-uniform statistics, differently weighted realizations, or all graph associahedra.
